items.exampleEn: The mother bird brings worms to nourish her babies.
items.exampleZh: 鳥媽媽帶蟲回來餵養雛鳥。

items.exampleEn: The new design improved the website's accessibility for users who cannot see well.
items.exampleZh: 新設計讓視力不好的使用者也更容易使用這個網站。

items.exampleEn: Some people snore when they sleep on their backs.
items.exampleZh: 有些人仰睡的時候會打鼾。

items.exampleEn: She yawned and said it was time for bed.
items.exampleZh: 她打了個哈欠，說該睡覺了。

items.exampleEn: The judge listened to both sides with calm detachment.
items.exampleZh: 法官以冷靜超然的態度聽取雙方的說法。

items.exampleEn: Good grades are not the only measure of attainment at school.
items.exampleZh: 好成績不是衡量在校成就的唯一標準。

items.exampleEn: I reorganized my bedroom over the weekend.
items.exampleZh: 我週末把房間重新整理了一遍。

items.exampleEn: We paid the movers before they left.
items.exampleZh: 我們在搬家工人離開前付了錢。

items.sentenceEn: Grandpa's snores kept the whole tent awake.
items.sentenceZh: 爺爺的鼾聲吵得整個帳篷的人都睡不著。

items.audioEn: My roommate snores so loudly that I bought ear plugs last week, and now I sleep fine.
items.audioZh: 我室友打鼾很大聲，所以我上星期買了耳塞，現在睡得很好。
items.questionZh: 說話者現在睡得怎麼樣？
options: Still kept awake by the noise

items.sentenceEn: Rain and sunshine nourish the young rice plants.
items.sentenceZh: 雨水和陽光滋養著稻子的幼苗。

items.sentenceEn: She told the sad story with surprising detachment.
items.sentenceZh: 她用出奇冷靜的態度講完那個悲傷的故事。

items.stemEn: The town added lower steps to its buses to improve ____ for elderly passengers.
items.stemZh: 鎮上把公車的階梯降低，讓年長的乘客更方便上下車。

items.stemEn: I couldn't hold back a big ____ during the long, boring meeting.
items.stemZh: 在冗長又無聊的會議中，我忍不住打了個大哈欠。

items.passageEn: Last month, my company moved to a new office downtown. Two movers arrived early and carried every desk down the stairs of our old building. The new office has much better accessibility, with wide doors and an elevator, so a colleague who uses a wheelchair can get around easily. Our manager reorganized the teams so that people who work together now sit together. The kitchen is small but cozy. On the first afternoon, I heard a loud yawn from the next desk. Everyone was tired, but the move went well.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我的公司搬到市中心的新辦公室。兩位搬家工人一早就到了，把每張桌子從舊大樓的樓梯搬下去。新辦公室的無障礙設計好多了，門很寬又有電梯，所以一位坐輪椅的同事可以輕鬆地四處移動。經理重新編組團隊，讓一起工作的人坐在一起。茶水間雖小但很溫馨。第一天下午，我聽到隔壁座位傳來一聲大大的哈欠。大家都累了，但搬遷很順利。

options: 替大家把東西裝進箱子裡

questions.questionZh: 新辦公室為什麼對坐輪椅的同事比較方便？
options: 離捷運站只要走兩分鐘
所有辦公桌都在同一層樓

items.promptZh: 達成這個目標花了我們五年。
referenceEn: The attainment of this goal took us five years.
Five years of hard work led to the attainment of this goal.
rubricZh: 要用 attainment（例如 the attainment of this goal）
「花了五年」可寫，例如 took us five years、It took us five years to 等

items.promptZh: 好的故事能滋養孩子的想像力。
referenceEn: Good stories can nourish a child's imagination.
A child's imagination can be nourished by good stories.
rubricZh: nourish 當動詞，主動句、被動句都可以（例如 can nourish…、can be nourished by… 等）
「孩子的想像力」可寫，例如 a child's imagination、children's imagination 等
寫成現在式（例如 Good stories nourish…）也正確
